title: Identification of potent BRD4-BD1 inhibitors using classical and steered molecular dynamics based free energy analysis.
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学和MM-PBSA方法筛选BRD4-BD1小分子抑制剂，对象为蛋白-小分子体系，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: In the present work a combination of traditional and steered molecular dynamics based techniques were employed to identify potential inhibitors against the human BRD4 protein (BRD4- BD1); an established drug target for multiple illnesses including various malignancies. Quinoline derivatives that were synthesized in-house were tested for their potential as new BRD4-BD1 inhibitors. Initially molecular docking experiments were performed to determine the binding poses of BRD4-BD1 inhibitors. To learn more about the thermodynamics of inhibitor binding to the BRD4-BD1 active site, the Molecular Mechanics Poisson-Boltzmann Surface Area (MM-PBSA) free energy calculations were conducted afterwards. The findings of the MM-PBSA analysis were further reinforced by performing steered umbrella sampling simulations which revealed crucial details about the binding/unbinding process of the most potent quinoline derivatives at the BRD4-BD1 active site. We report a novel quinoline derivative which can be developed into a fully functional BRD4-BD1 inhibitor after experimental validation. The identified compound (4 g) shows better properties than the standard BRD4-BD1 inhibitors considered in the study. The study also highlights the crucial role of Gln78, Phe79, Trp81, Pro82, Phe83, Gln84, Gln85, Val87, Leu92, Leu94, Tyr97, Met105, Cys136, Asn140, Ile146 and Met149 in inhibitor binding. The study provides a possible lead candidate and key amino acids involved in inhibitor recognition and binding at the active site of BRD4-BD1 protein. The findings might be of significance to medicinal chemists involved in the development of potent BRD4-BD1 inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，结合传统与导向分子动力学技术，旨在识别针对人BRD4蛋白（BRD4-BD1）的潜在抑制剂；该蛋白是多种疾病（包括多种恶性肿瘤）的既定药物靶点。内部合成的喹啉衍生物被测试其作为新型BRD4-BD1抑制剂的潜力。首先进行了分子对接实验以确定BRD4-BD1抑制剂的结合构象。为了更深入了解抑制剂与BRD4-BD1活性位点结合的热力学特性，随后进行了分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积（MM-PBSA）自由能计算。通过进行导向伞形采样模拟进一步强化了MM-PBSA分析的结果，这些模拟揭示了最有效的喹啉衍生物在BRD4-BD1活性位点结合/解离过程的关键细节。我们报告了一种新型喹啉衍生物，经过实验验证后，可开发为功能完整的BRD4-BD1抑制剂。所识别的化合物（4g）显示出比研究中考虑的标准BRD4-BD1抑制剂更优越的性质。该研究还强调了Gln78、Phe79、Trp81、Pro82、Phe83、Gln84、Gln85、Val87、Leu92、Leu94、Tyr97、Met105、Cys136、Asn140、Ile146和Met149在抑制剂结合中的关键作用。该研究提供了一个可能的先导候选物及参与BRD4-BD1蛋白活性位点抑制剂识别和结合的关键氨基酸。这些发现可能对从事强效BRD4-BD1抑制剂开发的药物化学家具有重要意义。
